experiment: Synthetic periodic anomaly added to real benign PCAP background
source_measurement: timestamps of TCP SYN packets without ACK, parsed from real PCAP files
validation: Leave-one-capture-out: the tested PCAP is excluded from threshold calibration.
threshold: 95th percentile of scores on training benign windows
masking: The same missing-observation mask is applied to the original and anomaly-injected version of each test window.
limitations: The anomaly is simulated by adding SYN packet counts to real benign traffic.
The simulated pulse pattern is known and aligned to the 200-second window.
Only TCP SYN packets without ACK are analysed.
The number of independent benign PCAP captures is small.
This experiment tests controlled detectability, not detection of an unknown real attack.
